hyprland-monochrome

A universal monochrome Hyprland desktop engineered in Pure C11, Lua 5.4, and POSIX shell that runs on any PC (AMD, Intel, NVIDIA, hybrid Optimus laptops, VMs & Arch/Debian/Fedora/openSUSE), opens any Linux or Windows app, and ships an OpenCode browser theme across Firefox & Chromium.

Hyprland 0.56 · Lua config · Pure C11 tools Any PC AMD · Intel · NVIDIA · Optimus · VM Any App Wayland · X11 · Flatpak · AppImage · Wine OpenCode Browser Theme + Startpage 176 keybinds 77 official packages kitty · thunar · Zsh + Starship

01Desktop layout & Wallpaper Studio

Tiled windows with 5px inner and 10px outer gaps, 10px rounding, a focused-window border that goes white-to-grey, bespoke monochrome vector cursors, and a frosted top bar.

Vector layout drawn to the real gap, rounding and bar geometry from modules/appearance.lua (docs/preview.svg).

The three floating groups of the bar, exactly as listed in waybar/config.jsonc — on screen they sit in one row, left · centre · right. Module values are sample data; the right group is ordered custom/sysgraph, memory, temperature, custom/updates, custom/keyboard, network, bluetooth, pulseaudio, battery, custom/perf, custom/focus, custom/recording, tray, clock, custom/settings, custom/power.
